digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep, Jira adapter transport layer
propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded and cannot detect when a classified mutating method is renamed or moved outside the swept transport modules.
Scanning unswept jira adapter modules reveals exactly two name collisions with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING, both in backend.py as pure self.transport delegations.

An anti-drift assertion must programmatically validate that any _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING name outside the four swept transport modules is only allowed as a pure same-name self.transport delegation with arguments forwarded unchanged.
The anti-drift guard must cover all eight unswept jira adapter modules including acli_subprocess.py and jira_fields.py, rejecting any guarded, retried, logged, or transformed variants.
The guard's acceptance set must be exactly the two known-benign backend.py facades; new accepted facades require explicit 429-policy classification.
